title: JVM runtime data areas trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for jvm-memory-structures trace events: the shared areas of one JVM instance (one of each) plus the private areas of every live thread, emitted by the visual.VisualMemoryAreas model.

threadCount.description: Number of live threads — and therefore of stacks, PC registers and native method stacks.

sharedAreaCount.description: Number of areas shared by the whole JVM instance. Always 4 here: heap, string pool, Metaspace, code cache.

perThreadAreaCount.description: Number of areas each single thread owns privately. Always 3: JVM stack, PC register, native method stack.

shared.description: The shared areas, in display order. Each exists exactly once per JVM instance.

insideHeap.description: true when this area physically lives inside the heap (the string pool, since Java 7)

items.description: what is stored in this area, in insertion order

label.description: technical label shown as-is, e.g. Order, Order.class, "OK", total()

owner.description: thread that stored it (the item is still shared); null when no thread is meaningful

threads.description: One entry per live thread, in start order; each entry is that thread's three private areas.

name.description: thread name, e.g. main or worker-1

pc.description: what this thread's PC register holds: '<method> @ <offset>', or '-' when it runs a native method

frames.description: this thread's JVM stack, bottom frame first

nativeFrames.description: this thread's native method stack, bottom frame first
